items: ✅ Unlock Studio-Grade Sound Customization (A Flagship Feature at an Unbeatable Price): Take full control of your audio with 9 EQ modes, including 6 fully customizable profiles via the DOQAUS app. This rare feature in budget-friendly over ear headphones lets you craft perfect sound for bass-heavy workouts, crystal-clear podcasts, or immersive movie nights.

items.label: ✅ Enjoy Rock-Solid Calls & Seamless Dual Connectivity with Bluetooth 5.4
items.value: Stay connected without drops. The advanced noise-reducing microphone ensures your voice is heard clearly on calls, even in noisy gyms or airports. Simultaneously connect to your phone and laptop, perfect for the multitasking professional or student.

items.label: ✅ Experience Cloud-Like Comfort for Extended Wear During Work or Travel
items.value: Plush memory foam ear cups and an adjustable headband make these over the ear headphones disappear on your head. Whether you‘re on a cross-country flight, in a marathon study session, or at your work-from-home desk, pressure and fatigue are eliminated.

items.value: Dual 40mm drivers deliver stunning, detailed sound. Combining flagship-level battery, customization, and comfort, these headphones wireless over ear offer incredible performance, making them perfect Christmas gifts for men and women who appreciate both quality and value.
